terminalSequence.description: A terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook: only OSC 0, 1, 2, 9, 99, 777 and BEL. Anything else makes the field ignored. Interactive sessions only, and not from an async hook.

decision.description: Declines, the same as action decline, and overrides an action in the same output. Read from Claude Code 2.1.284; ignored from 2.1.105 until then.

reason.description: Accepted and discarded: neither the user nor the server sees it.

action.description: accept answers for the user and skips the dialog (in url mode the URL never opens); decline and cancel send that to the server.

content.description: With accept: the form field values, keyed by the property names of requested_schema. It replaces the whole content object.

title: Elicitation hook output
description: Answers, changes, declines or cancels an MCP elicitation. Print nothing to leave it as it is. Exit code 2 declines, and a hookSpecificOutput without an action is ignored. Claude Code discards continue, systemMessage, stopReason on this event.
